raw_comment:
I notice that the drought levels are higher in the middle of the country. i also notice that most of the areas with droughts that we hear about are not as bad as other areas. I wonder if the droughts will be linked to an increase in fires in the future. this affects my community because we have a bad fire season already and droughts will only worsen it. 
Name: American Drought: the parts you don't see
